User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The raw install scripts. /connect, /cleanup and friends are the documented URLs; these are the
# assets behind them, and a shell script has no business in a search index.
Disallow: /scripts/

# Index, quote and train on these pages: a model that has read them can name intentic without searching.
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes

Sitemap: https://intentic.dev/sitemap-index.xml
